args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), replacing unhealthy v2.3.1 which exhibited an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. This incident records the production change for tracking purposes.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Verified pre-deploy state**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) but was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2**: Since v2.3.2 had never been deployed, the deploy was routed to the change-manager as per policy, who approved it. It rolled out to all production regions.
3. **Confirmed health**: v2.3.2 is healthy in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident** (INC-0001): Records the hotfix deployment context and current healthy status; the on-call engineer has been paged.
